# Josh Crites

> Josh Crites is an engineering and developer-experience leader based in the Detroit area. He builds developer tools, knowledge systems, and workflows that help people and AI agents use complex technology. This site is a personal collection of work, experiments, essays, books, and open questions.

From May 2022 to July 2026 Josh was Head of Developer Relations at Aztec Labs, working on Aztec and Noir. Before that he was a Developer Relations Engineer at cLabs / Celo Foundation and an Ethereum Educator at ConsenSys Academy. His recent work is about deploying AI inside organizations, agent-ready developer tooling, privacy, and how people keep their judgement as agents speed up learning and implementation.

The homepage (https://joshcrites.com/) is one page with these sections: Questions I'm exploring (#questions), Work and experiments (#work), Ideas and notes (#ideas), Library (#library), Now (#now), About (#about), and Contact (#contact).

## Work and experiments

- [AI-native developer support at Aztec]({{ "/posts/ai-native-developer-support-at-aztec/" | absolute_url }}): AI-assisted support workflows connecting models with versioned documentation, source repositories, community knowledge, and executable development environments.
- [Aztec Agent Builder Bench](https://github.com/critesjosh/aztec-agent-builder-bench): A benchmark for coding agents working with an unfamiliar system.
- [Aztec MCP server](https://github.com/AztecProtocol/mcp-server): An MCP server that gives coding agents context about Aztec.
- [Aztec Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/critesjosh/aztec-claude-plugin): A Claude Code plugin for Aztec development.
- [Aztec development environment](https://github.com/critesjosh/aztec-dev-env): A reproducible development environment for people and agents.
- [ContextReader](https://github.com/critesjosh/context-reader): A reading application with an S3-compatible Cloudflare R2 storage layer for uploaded documents.
- [Marginalia](https://github.com/critesjosh/marginalia/pull/39): A personal reading project with an opt-in intelligence layer built on Cloudflare Workers and Databricks (in development).
- [Agentic Wallet](https://github.com/critesjosh/agentic-wallet): An experiment in fine-tuning small models for wallet tasks, where deterministic code keeps control of approval and signing.
- [Bank of JubJub](https://github.com/Bank-of-JubJub/base): Private on-chain transfers using zero-knowledge proofs and homomorphic encryption.
- [On-device Aztec proving](https://github.com/critesjosh/aztec-mobile-proving): A native Android proof of concept for generating and verifying Aztec client-side proofs on the device.
- [Can't See Past My Shades](https://github.com/critesjosh/past-my-shades): An ETHDenver 2024 hackathon suite of private ERC-20 applications: sealed-bid auctions, private crowdfunding, and private token voting.
- [DreamLens](https://dreamlens.joshcrites.com): An experiment in using AI as an interpretive partner for exploring recurring symbols, patterns, and perspectives in one's inner life ([source](https://github.com/critesjosh/dreamlens)).
